cards.title: Publishing test: the terminal is connected
cards.question: Can the daily research task update this screen without a manual upload?
cards.selfCheck: GitHub publishing succeeded. The next test is an unattended scheduled run and automatic Fire HD refresh.

cards.title: Is the selloff spreading?
cards.question: How can you tell AI-specific weakness from broad risk aversion?
cards.selfCheck: Compare equal-weight stocks, small caps and credit spreads with semiconductors. Broad deterioration matters more than one index.

cards.title: Inference changes the memory bottleneck
cards.question: What happens when useful tokens require more memory movement?
cards.selfCheck: Track KV-cache size, memory bandwidth, tiering and production deployments—not just demonstrations.

cards.title: Yesterday’s capacity deal can shape next year
cards.question: Which past commitments are nearing qualification or production?
cards.selfCheck: Record original announcement, milestone, revenue mechanism and cancellation risk. Check whether forecasts include it.

cards.title: 2027 budgets will test AI economics
cards.question: What would change the outlook for AI infrastructure spending?
cards.selfCheck: Watch hyperscaler guidance, deployment schedules, utilization, power access and free cash flow.

cards.title: A rebound is not a regime change
cards.question: What evidence would convince you sentiment has truly improved?
cards.selfCheck: Look for broad participation, stable credit spreads and improving estimates. Define what would invalidate your view.
